notifications.title: Tonight's auditor ran before today's data audit
notifications.detail: The auditor started at 22:03 IST (16:33 UTC) and metrics/data-audit.json was from 11 Nov 16:21 UTC (24 h old). Today's Data audit run had not started yet: GitHub has been starting the 13:53 IST cron between 21:58 and 00:25 IST (16:19-18:55 UTC) for three days, so the dashboard-vs-YouTube check was skipped again. Yesterday's audit: 0 errors, 0 warnings across 55 checked videos.
notifications.fix: 1. Nothing broke; the audit lands later tonight. 2. To have the auditor check it each night, either trigger Data audit from the Netlify heartbeat like Publish, or move the auditor routine to 01:30 IST in claude.ai → Code → Routines (workflows and schedules are owner-only).

notifications.title: One bad setting row resets every setting to its default
notifications.detail: workers/lib/settings.ts validates the merged settings as one object and falls back to the defaults for everything when any row fails (its comment says bad rows are ignored). A row edited by hand in Supabase with a wrong type would quietly turn uploadsPaused off and restore the default upload times and daily target in every worker; the dashboard's getSettings does the same. The file is protected, so the auditor can't change it.
notifications.fix: 1. In a Claude Code session: in workers/lib/settings.ts, validate each row with SettingsSchema.shape[key].safeParse(row.value), keep the default only for rows that fail and print a ::warning:: naming the key. 2. Do the same in apps/dashboard/src/lib/store.db.ts getSettings. 3. Add a test with one bad row and uploadsPaused true.

notifications.title: The hourly watchdog runs only every 4-11 hours
notifications.detail: watchdog.yml is scheduled every hour, but GitHub ran it 11 times between 7 Nov 09:58 and 10 Nov 09:42 UTC (gaps of 4-11 hours). The hourly view snapshots behind the dashboard's 'realtime' chart and the 48-hour views therefore have gaps, and owner alerts can arrive hours late.
notifications.fix: Optional. 1. Accept it, or 2. start watchdog.yml from the Netlify publish heartbeat the way Publish is started (workflows are owner-only files).
